snippet.title: Of Ash and Steel - World Overview Trailer | tinyBuild Connect 2025
snippet.description:
Sign up for Playtest now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893820/Of_Ash_and_Steel/ 

In this world overview trailer, you'll discover the world of Of Ash and Steel through the eyes of Tristan — a cartographer by trade and a hero by chance.
 
Explore the diverse biomes of Grayshaft, encounter deadly creatures, and meet the island's vying factions. From ancient ruins, hidden treasures, and fierce battles to peaceful moments spent fishing or forging gear, this dangerous yet beautiful land has much to offer for curious adventurers.
